description: This file contains the implementation of the SmsWritePlatformService using JPA repositories in a Fineract-based project. It includes methods for creating, updating, and deleting SMS messages, along with exception handling related to data integrity issues.

classes.name: SmsWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation class of SmsWritePlatformService that handles SMS message persistence using JPA repositories, including create, update, and delete operations with data integrity handling.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Validates the input command, assembles an SmsMessage, persists it, and returns a result with the command and entity IDs.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Validates update command, retrieves the existing SmsMessage, applies updates, persists changes, and returns a processing result.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the SmsMessage identified by resourceId and handles potential data integrity exceptions.

methods.name: handleDataIntegrityIssues
methods.description: Handles data integrity exceptions, particularly checking for mobile number issues, logs errors, and throws appropriate exceptions.
